Every fact below was read from the Ministry of Public Works and Transport's own published service page at https://www.mpwt.gov.kh/kh/public-services/driver-s-license on 2026-07-31, including its FAQ. Nothing here is invented, illustrative, or rounded. This replaces the earlier [SAMPLE] corpus, which carried placeholder 'Prakas No. XXX' instruments and deliberately fake fees; sample and real content must not coexist in one index, because retrieval would then have to choose between a real fee and a placeholder one.
_instrumentNote: The service page cites no legal instrument. Each `instrument` below is the MPWT instrument whose OWN PUBLISHED TITLE covers the subject matter of the chunk, located in the ministry's document repository at https://www.mpwt.gov.kh/kh/documents/declaration and recorded with its real reference number and date. `article` is 'Not cited on source page' throughout — MPWT publishes these instruments as scanned PDFs that are not machine-readable at the URLs given, so article-level attribution could not be established and has not been guessed. The instrument identifies the governing law; the wording of each chunk comes from the service page, not from the instrument text.
_effectiveNote: `effective` is the signing date of the cited instrument, as published by MPWT. It is NOT a claim that the specific figure in the chunk was set on that date — fees in particular may have been revised after the instrument was signed. `verified` is the date the service page was read.
_stewardNote: Every chunk carries stewardApproved:false. Section 10.5 and FR-49 require a human at the ministry to approve fees, deadlines, required documents, eligibility and procedure steps before they reach a citizen. Reading an official page is not that approval.

chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: To exchange or renew a driving licence, a Cambodian citizen brings the old driving licence, the national identity card, a certificate of physical fitness, and three 4x6 photographs with a white background. The fee is 30,000 riel. Renewal can be done at the driving licence service centres at AEON Mall I and AEON Mall II, at Chip Mong Noro Mall, at the Ministry of Public Works and Transport, or at any of the 25 Phnom Penh and provincial departments of public works and transport. A licence that has expired can still be exchanged without sitting the examination again, but a late penalty applies.

chunks.instrument: Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. 1460 MEF.PrK dated 31 December 2019 on the provision of public services by the Ministry of Public Works and Transport
chunks.text: The examination fee for a driving licence, for Cambodian citizens, is 30,000 riel for category A, 90,000 riel for category B, 95,000 riel for categories C and D, and 100,000 riel for category E. For foreign nationals the fee is 100,000 riel for category A and 180,000 riel for category B. Exchange, renewal, duplicate and tertiary issue of a category A licence costs 20,000 riel, and 30,000 riel for categories B, C, D and E. Conversion of a foreign driving licence to a Cambodian one costs 120,000 riel.

chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — licence categories on the MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: There are five categories of driving licence: A, B, C, D and E. Category A covers motorcycles with a cylinder capacity above 125 cubic centimetres or an electric motor above 11 kilowatts, motorcycles towing a trailer, and three-wheeled motor vehicles. Category B covers vehicles carrying not more than 9 passengers including the driver. Category C covers goods vehicles with a maximum total weight above 3.5 tonnes, and may tow a trailer of maximum total weight not above 0.75 tonnes. Category D covers passenger vehicles carrying from 10 to 20 people including the driver, and may tow a trailer of maximum total weight not above 0.75 tonnes. Category E covers category B, C and D vehicles towing a trailer of maximum total weight above 0.75 tonnes, and is divided into E(B), E(C) and E(D). A category B licence does not permit riding a motorcycle above 125cc; that requires category A.

chunks.text: Where a driving licence is lost, the holder may request a duplicate. chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — foreign licence conversion on the MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: A foreign national holding a driving licence that is still valid and was issued by the competent authority of their own country may convert it to a Cambodian driving licence. The documents required are a passport and a visa valid for at least 30 days, excluding tourist visas; the foreign driving licence, for verification purposes only; a certificate of current address issued by the commune or sangkat chief or by the commune or sangkat administrative police post; a certificate of physical fitness; and 4x6 photographs with a white background. Where the foreign licence is not in English or French it must be translated into English or Khmer by the embassy of the holder's country. The fee is 120,000 riel.

chunks.text: Applications to sit the driving licence examination are received at public service locations designated by the Ministry of Public Works and Transport, including AEON Mall 1, AEON Mall 2, the one-window service units of Phnom Penh and the provinces, the heavy vehicle training centre, and the Phnom Penh and provincial departments of public works and transport nationwide. chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — validity and late renewal FAQ on the MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: A category A or category B driving licence obtained by examination is valid for 10 years. A category C, D or E licence is valid for 5 years. A driving licence that has been expired for more than 30 days attracts a penalty on renewal of 500 riel per day for small vehicles and 2,000 riel per day for large vehicles. A licence that expired long ago can still be exchanged without sitting the examination again, but the penalty applies.

chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — examination stages FAQ on the MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: The driving licence examination has two stages: a theory examination and a practical driving examination. A candidate who passes the theory examination on the computer system is then entitled to sit the practical examination at an examination ground or on a public road designated by the ministry. A candidate who fails the theory examination may not sit the practical examination and must re-sit the theory examination; no waiting period is set before re-sitting, and the practical examination becomes available only once the theory examination is passed.

chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: An application to sit the driving licence examination or to exchange a driving licence may be made through the ministry's automated driving licence system at https://driverlicense.mpwt.gov.kh. The applicant creates an account on the site, activates it from the link sent to their email address, and can then log in to lodge the application. Applications for category A and category B may be made through the automated system. For category C and above, the applicant must first study at a driving school and obtain a certificate recognising their driving before becoming entitled to apply to sit the examination. The documents for the examination are the identity card, three 4x6 photographs with a white background, and a certificate of physical fitness.

chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — category change FAQ on the MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: A holder of a category B licence who wishes to move to category C may do so, but must sit the category C examination again. The documents required are the Khmer national identity card, a certificate of physical fitness, a certificate of study from a motor vehicle driving school for categories C, D and E, 4x6 photographs with a white background, and the payment receipt. The examination fee is 95,000 riel. A holder of a category C, D or E licence may request a change to category B, which is then valid for 10 years, but may not change to category A; and once changed to category B, may not change back to category C, D or E.

chunks.doc: Driver's Licence — foreign nationals sitting the examination, FAQ on the MPWT public service page
chunks.instrument: Prakas No. 047 SK dated 27 January 2017 on the formalities and procedures for issuing driving licences and points cards
chunks.text: A foreign national who has entered and is residing in Cambodia lawfully may sit the examination for a Cambodian category A or category B driving licence. The licence is valid for 10 years. The documents required are a passport and a visa valid for at least 15 days, excluding tourist visas; a certificate of current address issued by the commune or sangkat chief or by the commune or sangkat administrative police post; a certificate of physical fitness; and three 4x6 photographs with a white background. The fee for category B is 180,000 riel.
